weather_report:
The dawn breaks gently over Boston, a tender reminder of summer’s lingering warmth. As the sun rises, it casts a golden hue across the landscape, inviting today’s revelers to step outside and embrace a mostly sunny day with temperatures hovering pleasantly near 89 degrees. The air is infused with a hint of a southwest breeze, whispering soft promises of a delightful day ahead. 

Tonight, as the sun dips below the horizon, the sky will shift to a more relaxed palette of partly cloudy tones, settling into a cozy low of around 70. With the breeze picking up slightly, it may be wise to wear layers to accommodate the bustling warmth of the afternoon and the comforting coolness of the evening. A stroll down the waterfront or a visit to one of the many parks would be a splendid way to savor these conditions — perhaps a quiet coffee in hand, taking note of the laughter of passersby and the sound of rustling leaves. The world is alive, and Boston, draped in its summer essence, invites you to partake.
